name: CoachMark
summary: Onboarding tooltip with a backdrop spotlight (dark scrim with a cut-out around the anchor element). Sequenced via a CoachMarkTour wrapper that walks through 3-6 steps with 'Skip' / 'Next' / 'Done'. Distinct from Tooltip (hover, single, transient) and Popover (click, richer content).

anchor.description: Ref to the DOM node the spotlight cuts around.

description.description: One sentence. Tour copy should be progressive — Step 1 sets context, last step lands a benefit.

stepIndex.description: 1-indexed current step. Shown as '2 of 5' in the footer.

wcag: 2.1.2 No Keyboard Trap (intentional, exit via Skip / Escape)
rules: role='dialog' + aria-modal='false' (the user can still click around to dismiss).
The spotlight backdrop must NOT block screen reader access to the anchored element — only visually dim.
The Skip control MUST always be visible — coach marks that can't be dismissed are dark patterns.
Honor prefers-reduced-motion: drop the entry zoom; keep the fade.

do: Lead each step with the benefit, not the mechanic: 'Track shipment delays in one click', not 'This is the alerts tab'.
Position the bubble adjacent to the anchor; auto-flip when the viewport doesn't fit.
dont: Don't auto-start a tour on every login. First-visit only, with a 'Replay tour' affordance in Help.
Don't gate the tour — the user must be free to skip and use the app immediately.
Don't render coach marks over a destructive action.
Don't paint the spotlight ring in solid lime — use a 2 px text.accent stroke around the cut-out.

changelog.note: Initial CoachMark contract. Backdrop spotlight + bubble + sequenced tour.
